name: Dyadic Interaction Platform: A novel tool to study transparent social interactions
description: Data Sources Summary This entry summarizes the data sources used for the paper “Dyadic Interaction Platform: A novel tool to study transparent social interactions” published by eLife (https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.106757.1). Original source: https://osf.io/8r6e2/ Transparent Economic Games The BoS dataset described in this section and links to the GitHub code repositories are available at the public OSF repository: https://osf.io/f5u8z. Continuous Strategic Interactions Competitive Foraging task: Data and code are available at https://osf.io/8r6e2/files/osfstorage. Cooperation–Competition Foraging study: Data and code are available at the public OSF repository https://osf.io/56hw7. Perceptual Decision-Making in Dyadic Context The data and code related to the CPR DIP dataset are available here: https://osf.io/8r6e2/files/osfstorage. Attention and Social Learning The dataset and code described in this section are available at the public OSF repository: https://osf.io/6dven.
